summary: Backend-only testing for Instant Demand + AI Daily Summary + trains regression. Ran /app/backend/tests/test_instant_demand_and_summary.py via pytest. TASK 1 (Instant Demand per terminal) PASSES 100%. TASK 2 (AI Daily Summary endpoints) FAILS because the endpoints are NOT implemented in the backend at all - GET /api/events/daily-summary returns 405, POST /api/events/daily-summary/regenerate returns 404. Trains regression PASSES.

critical.issue: Endpoint NOT IMPLEMENTED. Returns 405 Method Not Allowed because path matches the DELETE /events/{event_id} route in /app/backend/routers/events.py (treating 'daily-summary' as an event_id). No GET handler exists.

Endpoint NOT IMPLEMENTED. Returns 404 Not Found. No route registered in /app/backend/routers/events.py or anywhere else in /app/backend/. Grep for 'daily-summary' / 'daily_summary' in backend code returns only test files - no implementation.

action_items: Implement GET /api/events/daily-summary endpoint that returns {summary, sources, search_queries, date, generated_at} with 4 sections: [GRANDES EVENTOS], [TEATROS Y OCIO], [ALERTAS DE TRÁFICO], [PREVISIÓN MAÑANA], Telegram **bold** markers, sources list, and >=5 search_queries.
Implement POST /api/events/daily-summary/regenerate that is admin-gated (401/403 when unauth, 200 with admin Bearer token) and returns {success: true, summary: '...'}.
Add the new daily-summary router BEFORE the catch-all DELETE /events/{event_id} route (or use a non-collision path prefix) to avoid the 405 collision currently observed.
Daily-summary feature depends on GEMINI_API_KEY in backend/.env (Google Search Grounding). Verify the key is valid; if not, surface a 503 with a clear message rather than 500.
critical_code_review_comments: Path-parameter route /events/{event_id} (DELETE) shadows any future GET /events/<literal> route, producing 405 instead of 404 for unknown sub-paths. Consider moving literal routes above parameterised ones or using a more specific prefix.
/app/backend/server.py uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'); migrate to lifespan event handlers (FastAPI warning).
server.py is very large; daily-summary, when added, should live in its own router module (e.g. /app/backend/routers/daily_summary.py) per the existing routers structure.

Once the main agent implements the daily-summary router, re-run pytest /app/backend/tests/test_instant_demand_and_summary.py.
rca of the issue: RCA for daily-summary failures: (1) Searched all backend code for 'daily-summary' and 'daily_summary' - only present in test files, no implementation in routers/ or server.py. (2) GET returns 405 instead of 404 because in routers/events.py the route DELETE /events/{event_id} matches 'daily-summary' as an event_id parameter, so FastAPI reports the method (GET) is not allowed for that resource. (3) POST /api/events/daily-summary/regenerate returns 404 because no route is registered for that path at all. Mitigation: implement the router with both endpoints; register the static path BEFORE the {event_id} catch-all, or move daily-summary under a distinct prefix (e.g. /api/daily-summary) to avoid the collision.
